# GitHub Repository Description

Use these descriptions for your GitHub repository settings:

## Short Description (135 characters max)

```
A modern social media platform for sharing images, connecting with users, and discovering trending content built with Django
```

## Long Description / About

```
Django Social is an open-source social media platform built with Django 5.1 and Python 3.9+. Users can share images, build communities, like content, follow other users, and discover trending images. Features include user authentication, OAuth2 integration, image ranking, responsive design, Docker support, and a full admin dashboard.
```

## Topics (Tags)

- django
- python
- social-media
- image-sharing
- web-application
- open-source
- community

## Website (if applicable)

https://django-social.example.com

---

## How to Update on GitHub

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click **Settings** (gear icon)
3. In the **About** section on the right sidebar, click the edit icon
4. Fill in:
   - **Description**: Use the Short Description above
   - **Website**: Add your deployed URL
   - **Topics**: Add the topics listed above

Or use GitHub's web interface to set these fields directly.

---

## Additional Recommendations

### Repository Settings

- ✅ Enable "Discussions"
- ✅ Enable "Issues"
- ✅ Enable "Sponsorships"
- ✅ Set default branch to "main"
- ✅ Enable branch protection rules for main

### Social Preview

Consider creating a GitHub social preview image (.github/social-preview.png) with:

- Django Social logo/title
- Brief tagline
- Key features icons
